label: The Unsigned Letter
summary: On your first night as the new lighthouse keeper you find a love letter addressed to the keeper, but not to you.
title: The Unsigned Letter
description: A letter tucked behind the lamp-room logbook is addressed to 'the keeper'. It is recent, it is unsigned, and it was not meant for you.

chapterOutlines.title: The Lamp Room
chapterOutlines.outline: Arrive, find the letter, meet the ferry captain.

chapterOutlines.title: Low Tide
chapterOutlines.outline: Ask around town without giving the secret away.

chapterOutlines.title: The Harvest Dance
chapterOutlines.outline: The letter's writer will be at the dance.

scene.location: The lamp room at the top of the Wrenmouth lighthouse
scene.summary: Evening, first night on the job. The lamp hums. A folded letter has slipped out from behind the old logbook.

openThreads: Who wrote the letter, and who was it for?

npcs.name: Mara Quill
npcs.description: Runs the twice-daily ferry and knows every rumor in town before it lands.
personality: terrible at keeping a straight face
goals: Keep the ferry running through the storm season
abilities: Reads the weather better than the forecast
